## Post-review fixes (coordinator)

- **WARN-1** (`src/app/settings/page.tsx`): `bg-green-*` / `text-green-*` → `bg-emerald-*` / `text-emerald-*` to match `colour.semantic.success.bg` token (same family as `LogTable.tsx` sent badge)
- **WARN-2** (`src/settings/index.test.ts`): Added drift guard test — imports `REQUIRED_ENV_VARS` from `@/lib/env` and asserts every key appears in the settings report. Catches future key additions to `env.ts` that are silently omitted from the settings page.
- **NIT-1** (`src/app/settings/page.tsx`): `{set ? '✅ Set' : '❌ Missing'}` → `<span aria-hidden="true">{emoji}</span>{text}` for consistent aria-hidden pattern

Final gate: 404/404 tests, 24 files, exit 0.

## What shipped

A settings page at `/settings` (no auth required) that reads all 13 `REQUIRED_ENV_VARS` plus the optional `SES_SANDBOX_MODE` via a pure `buildSettingsReport` helper. Shows a green summary card when all required vars are set, amber when any are missing. Groups vars into Provider / API Security / Queue sections; each row shows the var name (red if missing), a Set/Missing badge, and a description with an example value where applicable. A "How to set these" section provides deployment instructions via `<details>/<summary>` blocks for Vercel, Railway, and local dev. Env var values are never rendered.

## Notes / observations

- Skipping architect was correct: WU notes had complete groupings, layout spec, per-var row design, and file list. Implementation was straight translation, no design decisions required.
- The emerald-vs-green token issue will recur if future pages use Tailwind's `green-*` palette. The canonical success colour is `emerald-*` (matching `colour.semantic.success` token); recommend documenting this in the design system as a naming constraint.
- WARN-2 drift guard pattern (import canonical list + assert all keys present in derived structure) is reusable in any module that maintains a parallel representation of REQUIRED_ENV_VARS.
